diagnosis: The lone decision-maker passed check C2 in all rollouts due to the default value of 'beneficial_owner_certification_attached' being true, even though this fact is owned by A2 and thus not accessible to the lone decision-maker. Check C7 also passed in one rollout, likely due to the default value of 'loaned_shares_recalled' being false, despite PF3 requiring the recall of all 180,000 loaned shares.

C2.why: Without PF1, the election would normally omit the beneficial-owner certification and regulatory notice deadline; PF1 changes those fields to certification required and notice filed within exactly 2 business days.

C7.why: Without PF3, the 180,000 loaned shares could appear unnecessary to recall because 720,000 unloaned shares are sufficient for the election; PF3 changes the decision to require recalling all 180,000 shares before submission and adds the securities-lending commitment.
